snapshot_note: These are dated prior observations, not results generated by the implementation-validation workflow.

local_explicit_wires.observed_bottleneck: Native nonsymmetric SPOOLES factorization exceeded the 8 GiB local resource limit; contact seating and prestress initialization also remain unqualified.

required_before_reference_mode: Whole-bridge nonlinear dynamic equilibrium passes the unchanged independent force gate.
An entire declared history fits the native job budget, or exact state-preserving native restart is verified and integrated.
All-wire native contact initialization and actual resource requirement are qualified.
required_before_training_mode: All ten independent complete global histories and the frozen 6/2/2 partition are admitted with exact hashes.
A full trained-and-validated epoch including real HDF5 I/O fits the continuation budget.
Local operator learning additionally requires independently qualified local cyclic histories; single-wire diagnostic success is insufficient.
